description: This file contains configuration-related functions and constants for the Mattermost server, including methods for managing server and app configurations, environment overrides, cryptographic keys, and email settings.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Represents the Mattermost server instance, providing configuration and system management functions.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents the application layer with methods for configuration, environment, and security management.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Handles channel-related functionalities, including cryptographic secrets and system keys.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns the server or app configuration.

methods.name: EnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable overrides for configuration.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the current configuration.

methods.name: IsConfigReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is read-only.

methods.name: ReloadConfig
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from the source.

methods.name: ClientConfig
methods.description: Returns the client configuration map.

methods.name: ClientConfigHash
methods.description: Returns a hash of the client configuration.

methods.name: LimitedClientConfig
methods.description: Returns a limited client configuration map.

methods.name: AddConfigListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for configuration changes.

methods.name: AddLicenseListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for license changes.

methods.name: RemoveConfigListener
methods.description: Removes a configuration change listener by ID.

methods.name: ensurePostActionCookieSecret
methods.description: Ensures the PostActionCookie secret key exists and is valid.

methods.name: ensureInstallationDate
methods.description: Ensures the system installation date is recorded.

methods.name: ensureFirstServerRunTimestamp
methods.description: Ensures the first server run timestamp is recorded.

methods.name: AsymmetricSigningKey
methods.description: Returns the private key used for asymmetric signing.

methods.name: PostActionCookieSecret
methods.description: Returns the PostActionCookie secret.

methods.name: GetCookieDomain
methods.description: Returns the cookie domain based on site URL and subdomain allowance.

methods.name: GetSiteURL
methods.description: Returns the site URL.

methods.name: GetConfigFile
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration file by name.

methods.name: GetSanitizedConfig
methods.description: Returns a sanitized configuration without secrets.

methods.name: SanitizedConfig
methods.description: Sanitizes a configuration object for admin viewing.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Returns environment variable overrides for configuration.

methods.name: SaveConfig
methods.description: Saves a new configuration and optionally notifies cluster peers.

methods.name: HandleMessageExportConfig
methods.description: Adjusts message export settings based on toggles.

methods.name: MailServiceConfig
methods.description: Returns SMTP email configuration based on server settings.
